target.name: Unone spatial batch API
target.scope: Repository public CLI/docs/canonical types and headless CPU spatial authoring, supplemented by independent bounded source/design review. Excludes fresh SDK-only authoring, GPU runtime execution, rendering, performance speedup, device-loss and cross-platform certification.
target.revision: Existing debug executable SHA256 a5da57e920476a7665aab1905f3e48f8c78f1693dbe6f3ac349fba1ad15c587f; checkout 7b9424cf42d0409633c9ce782503075bd09018f9 with preserved uncommitted changes; selected hashes identify the reviewed source.
target.environment: Windows x64, existing game.exe and Node v24.19.0; synthetic local CPU projects only; no build/install/network/accounts or product/game changes.

entryPoints: game api search / describe / typings and public check --types / run
limitations: Aggregate assessment is informed: the root implemented the feature and read source. Only blind/ is a fresh-context public-interface subtrial; independent source findings are separately labelled.

Trial counters refer only to the preserved blind lane; parallel informed recorder commands are not added to that exploration sequence. The two wrong guesses are natural cross-API assumptions, not deliberate negatives or the later shell-quoting failure.
Blind first geometry succeeded at operation 17; final strictly typed example at 23–24. Initial bootstrap stdout was durably recaptured later and is not mislabelled original recorder output.

The initial informed capture genuinely failed. Its generic 65-case failure is not overflow evidence because observation serialization failed first. The corrected capture explicitly projects one info field and verifies overflow-specific diagnostics.
No engine/source fixes were applied. Workaround success is not a repaired product or a fresh blind retest.

No actual GPU execution or new SDK pack in this audit. Previous implementation validation is not substituted for this public-interface trial. SDK guide omission is based on complete source inventory tracing.
One fresh AI author is a single trial, not a statistical usability result. Evidence coverage refers to the ten scoped rubric questions, not all engine features.

dimensions.title: 用途與起點
dimensions.question: 陌生 AI 從入口能否說明工具解決什麼、不解決什麼，以及下一個正確操作？
dimensions.answer: A fresh AI followed README to the spatial guide and correctly explained generic geometry, CPU default, fixed delivery, and the absence of movement policy or speedup claims.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain the explicit ownership and v1 limits; add a minimal typed observation example that works without adapters.

dimensions.title: 能力與限制發現
dimensions.question: 如何查到目前版本真正可用的功能、相依條件與未實作能力，而不是猜 API？
dimensions.answer: The spatial namespace, eight operations, canonical types, backend names and limits are publicly discoverable from repository entrypoints. Ordinary collision and Chinese query phrases return no matches.
dimensions.nextAction: Add scoped collision/CCD and bilingual discovery terms, link the complete guide from descriptors, and include the guide in SDK inventory.

dimensions.title: 可執行操作契約
dimensions.question: 只靠可發現的契約及最小例子能否完成代表任務？輸入欄位、回傳及副作用是否明確？
dimensions.answer: The independent AI completed masked nearest, ordered overlap and moving-target sweep at operation 17, and a strictly typed final example at operations 23–24. The informed packed/table scenario also completes.
dimensions.nextAction: Make result publication compose with the official ObservationValue contract, then rerun a new independent first-use trial.

dimensions.title: 上下文與需求真相
dimensions.question: 是否保留 ID、關聯、版本、來源與待決事項？AI 能否取得必要脈絡而不把推測當需求？
dimensions.answer: Versioned query results retain their submitted geometry after replacement and index destruction. The corrected public probe verifies version 2 results after a version 3 replacement and checks stable same-seed digests.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep snapshot/version contracts explicit and add public context for faulted tickets without implying durable handle restoration.

dimensions.title: 結果與狀態觀察
dimensions.question: 如何查到實際變更、進度、完成、失敗與限制？是否把已送出、執行成功、人類驗收分開？
dimensions.answer: Selected results and portable scalar info fields publish correctly, but two natural observation paths fail: SpatialBatchResult fails official typecheck, and info() is typed as publishable but its safe_integer field fails native observation serialization.
dimensions.nextAction: Align spatial return types and numeric domains with the observation boundary; require unadapted info/result publication to pass both check --types and native/Web runtime tests.

dimensions.title: 具體錯因與修復
dimensions.question: 故意做錯一次：回應是否指出錯誤碼、欄位或物件、實際值與預期、具體原因及可採取的修復？修正後重跑是否成功？
dimensions.answer: Duplicate IDs, negative radius, same-tick take, consumed/cancelled tickets and stale destruction produce usable failures; valid repairs succeed. Direct info publication gives a generic portable-integer error requiring field isolation.
dimensions.nextAction: Add field-level diagnostics for publication failures and consistent documented array indexing; preserve stable existing error codes.

dimensions.title: 重試、衝突與恢復
dimensions.question: 重複請求、狀態過時、失去回覆或中斷時，AI 能否判斷安全重試、續接或需人類介入，不重複副作用？
dimensions.answer: Caught early-take errors do not consume tickets; later take succeeds, consumed tickets reject retries, and cancelled work is absent. After the declared terminal 65-contact overflow, a fresh corrected 64-contact run succeeds.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep per-call validation versus terminal executor faults distinct in discovery; add a small public recovery example and separately test GPU interruption.

dimensions.title: 權限與作用範圍
dimensions.question: 讀寫、目標專案／裝置、批准與外部副作用是否可查且實際受到限制？以一個越界操作驗證。
dimensions.answer: The isolated probe uses only new synthetic projects, rejects invalid/stale operations and verifies an unrelated scene entity remains unchanged after batch queries.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain synthetic boundary tests and opaque handles; do not add domain-specific selection or response rules to these primitives.

dimensions.title: 效能與成本定位
dimensions.question: 能否觀察這類工具相關的耗時、資源或成本及瓶頸？無法量測是否明說而不回傳假零？不要求每種工具都有 GPU 指標。
dimensions.answer: Public runs expose actual CPU script/physics/observe timings, frame statistics, counts and Luau memory, as well as capacity and selected backend. The successful two-frame sample reports total 1.006 ms and phase totals 0.767/0.027/0.130 ms. These target measurements are distinct from command wall times.
dimensions.nextAction: Expose spatial work costs or explicit unavailability, then profile a bounded end-to-end batch workload before choosing automatic execution thresholds.

dimensions.title: 版本與可重現驗證
dimensions.question: 能否保留版本指紋、環境、輸入、輸出及可重跑步驟？如何知道修改後原失敗案例確實已修复？
dimensions.answer: The audit pins the existing executable by SHA-256, fingerprints 33 selected subject files, retains failed and workaround captures, verifies the 26-file blind evidence seal, and repeats the same-seed scenario with equal digests.
dimensions.nextAction: After fixes, preserve these failed cases and run a new captured retest plus a new SDK-only blind author; do not relabel an informed retest as blind.

issues.summary: Officially typed spatial.info() cannot be directly published through observation.set on the native CLI.
issues.cause: limits.safe_integer is 2^53-1; the observation integer branch permits only signed 32-bit values. The declared ObservationValue dictionary and runtime numeric behavior disagree.
issues.fix: Align the diagnostic value representation or shared serialization contract; retain numeric bounds explicitly without a caller-only undocumented workaround.
issues.verification: The unadapted info() value must pass official typecheck and direct observation publication on native and Web hosts; retain the failing blind/info-probe.

issues.summary: A SpatialBatchResult cannot be passed directly to typed observation.set.
issues.cause: Canonical result records do not compose with the recursive ObservationValue type accepted by the observation API; the fresh author had to write an explicit typed adapter.
issues.fix: Provide compatible canonical types or a generic supported serialization path and a working typed result-observation example.
issues.verification: The preserved first example should pass check --types and publish without local casts, any stubs or a bespoke spatial adapter.

issues.summary: A valid tiny coordinate faults the CPU manager with an invalid result produced by its own executor.
issues.cause: normal_or_z squares a 3e-23 displacement; f32 subnormal rounding produces a normal with length squared about 0.642, which validate_result rejects.
issues.fix: Use scale-safe normalization across CPU/WGSL or reject a clearly documented unsupported minimum scale before accepting the batch.
issues.verification: A body at {3e-23,0,0}, radius0, queried from origin must complete with finite validated contact geometry; add nearby tiny/zero/scaled cases.

issues.summary: The complete spatial guide is omitted by portable SDK packing.
issues.cause: The SDK authoring/runtime-package inventory has no spatial-batches.md entry, and spatial descriptors do not link to the full guide. Repository README discovery is not SDK-only validation.
issues.fix: Bundle the canonical guide, link selected contracts to it, and add an inventory test before fresh SDK authoring.
issues.verification: Inspect a newly packed SDK, then let a fresh agent discover host policy and moving-sphere semantics without repository source.
